issue_request: FHIR-5455 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot issue asking that the acronym GTIN be defined on first use in the Device resource.
initial_application: A 2015 Device notes change in commit 7d67ca802e5a4a4a472dcba2a975d3e1b6b9a230 expanded the acronym as Global Trade Item Number (GTIN). Later Device notes and UDI carrier refactors reintroduced unexpanded GTIN mentions in current source.
additional_context: Device and DeviceDefinition are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-43063 added Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifierSystem and FHIR-47419 later harmonized Device and DeviceDefinition identifier-system wording, so the reconciliation keeps those active parallel definitions aligned. Generated-looking SVG copies were left untouched.
reconciliation: Changed source/device/device-notes.xml, source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml, and source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml to spell out Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) while preserving the approved Device/DeviceDefinition semantics.
source_changes: source/device/device-notes.xml: expanded GTIN in the Device identifier/type notes and UDI explanatory note.
source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: expanded GTIN in the parallel DeviceDefinition identifier-system definitions.

related_jiras.note: Later Device identifier/type guidance refactor around GTIN contributed to current unexpanded note text; it was context only and not independently decided.
Added Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifierSystem, creating active definition text that could surface GTIN before the notes.
Harmonized Device and DeviceDefinition deviceIdentifierSystem wording with the unexpanded acronym; this commit preserves the harmonized semantics while expanding GTIN.
